note: Setup manifest only; not an automatically executable ServiceNow import. Verify actual generated table and field names.

tables.name: x_1234_cafenow_checkout
tables.label: CafeNow Checkout

fields.state: Choice(String): processing, submitted, fulfilled, rejected, unknown

tables.access: Technical checkout metadata: no employee/vendor direct table CRUD; service-only writes, restricted application administrators inspect/reconcile. Do not expose on portal forms.

tables.name: x_1234_cafenow_pickup_reservation
tables.label: CafeNow Pickup Reservation
tables.access: No employee/vendor direct table CRUD; reservations are server-managed and cannot be edited to bypass capacity.

existing_order_additions.pickup_date: Date. Verify whether one already exists before adding.
existing_order_additions.checkout_context: Reference x_1234_cafenow_checkout with a UNIQUE database index for nonblank values. Preserve existing Order records.

existing_references.Order.time_slot_v2: User-reported Pickup Window reference; configure order_window_field to actual technical name (older export used pickup_window)
existing_references.sc_req_item.x_1234_cafenow_cafenow: Existing Order reference in retained export; verify before installing Flow action

system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.catalog_id: Actual CafeNow sc_catalog sys_id; required even for cart preview
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.window_time_stor: Confirm raw values against a known window: wall_clock for raw 11:30:00 meaning 11:30 New York; utc_1970 for raw 1970-01-01 16:30:00 meaning 11:30 New York. Empty/unsupported modes block window loading.
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.terms_url: Actual portal page query such as ?id=cafenow_terms; create/review the page before enabling
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.terms_version: Version for the actual displayed terms; bump whenever terms change
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.building_locatio: Actual cmn_location sys_id for the pilot building; required by Order form
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.order_window_fie: time_slot_v2 OR the verified technical Order Pickup Window reference
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.order_user_field: opened_by OR verified recipient reference; default opened_by means self ordering only
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.enabled: false initially; true after setup and verification
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.storage_verified: false initially; true only after real duplicate-index and reservation tests
system_properties.x_1234_cafenow.checkout.enforce_order_gu: false during setup; true before enabling dedicated checkout for employees
